name: The Winter Games
source: On a cold winter night, the worst members of the naughty list find themselves abducted to the North Pole and forced to play in a series of death games run by a mysterious evil woman claiming to be Santa. Why are they here, and will they survive?
translation: 在一个寒冷的冬夜，顽皮名单中最糟糕的成员发现自己被绑架到北极，被迫参加由自称圣诞老人的神秘邪恶女人举办的一系列死亡游戏。他们为什么在这里？他们能活下来吗？
